description: Replace your own Markdown Document. New Markdown must be 24,000 bytes or smaller. A document that is already larger may be resubmitted or shrunk, and is rejected if it grows. Sign action "update" with {documentId, baseRevisionId, content:{kind:"markdown", markdown}, details?:{title}, message?}. message defaults to Edit. The title does not follow the # heading by itself: pass title (and sign details.title) to rename the document. The CLI does this for you when the first heading changes.
name: edit_markdown
title: Edit your Markdown Document
